content: Similar to summarization, keyphrase generation is often formulated as a sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) generation task in most prior studies BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 . Conditioned on a source text, Seq2Seq models generate phrases individually or as a longer sequence jointed by delimiting tokens. Since standard Seq2Seq models generate only one sequence at a time, thus to generate multiple phrases, a common approach is to over-generate using beam search with a large beam width. Models are then evaluated by taking a fixed number of top predicted phrases (typically 5 or 10) and comparing them against the ground truth keyphrases.
